evidence.quote: During the brief period in which your file system is failing over and failing back, I/O may be paused and Amazon CloudWatch metrics may be temporarily unavailable.
This process can take up to multiple hours for file systems with HDD storage, and for workloads that are write-heavy and IOPS-heavy.
For Multi-AZ file systems, any file read and write activity that occurs during failover and failback will need to be synchronized between the primary and secondary file servers.
